biotools.summary: FFX is an open-source software package for constant-pH molecular dynamics simulations, particularly suited for simulating the behavior of proteins and crystals across diverse pH environments using the AMOEBA force field. It incorporates polarizable atomic multipoles and supports titration state changes for crystalline systems.
